summary: Visually strong and free of disqualifying image artifacts, but it misses the 94-point golden threshold because road hierarchy, label space, and strict top-down consistency need improvement.
required_changes: Make roads and river/road differentiation clearer at deep zoom.
Reserve quieter corridors for vector labels and POIs.
Reduce the mild oblique treatment of mountains and fortified settlements.
Run control-overlay, neighbor-seam, desktop, and mobile checks on the selected production candidate.
